activity_summary: You heard the market from the floor and did not go. The wheat, if the sellers were still honest, was the same six-and-thirty you had already written. Staying up here was the back, not a principle.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was not going down, and stopped.

entities.name: wheat at six-and-thirty shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in Market, from the floor

facets.activity: Heard the market from the floor

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Six-and-thirty, if they are still honest.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The floor is the market I get. It is not a virtue. It is a back.
